products.title: Fiskars PowerGear2 Softgrip Pruner
products.specs: Bypass pruner, model 392791-1001; 3/4 in cut capacity; hardened steel blade with low-friction coating; Softgrip handle; limited lifetime warranty.
products.body_html:
A geared bypass pruner from the PowerGear2 Softgrip line, built for tougher stems and light branches. The cam mechanism multiplies leverage through the middle of the cut, where resistance is highest.

  • Bypass cutting action for clean, precise cuts
  • 3/4 in (19 mm) cutting capacity
  • Fully hardened steel blade with a low-friction coating
  • Softgrip handle
  • Limited lifetime warranty from Fiskars

Specifications summarized from Fiskars product information (model 392791-1001). Demonstration listing — not an authorized Fiskars reseller.

products.title: Fiskars Steel D-Handle Digging Shovel (46 in)
products.specs: 46 in overall length; welded 14-gauge hardened steel blade; 18-gauge steel shaft; D-handle; powder-coated; lifetime warranty.
products.body_html:
An all-steel digging shovel with a large D-handle for two-handed control in dense soil.

  • Welded 14-gauge hardened steel blade
  • 18-gauge steel shaft
  • Sharpened blade edge for penetrating tough soil
  • Powder-coated finish resists rust and cleans easily
  • 46 in overall length; limited lifetime warranty

Specifications summarized from Fiskars product information. Demonstration listing — not an authorized Fiskars reseller.

products.title: FELCO 2 Classic Pruning Shears
products.specs: Swiss-made bypass pruner; 8.46 in length; 0.55 lb; 0.98 in cut capacity; forged aluminum handles; hardened steel blade; right-handed, large.
products.body_html:
The FELCO 2 is a Swiss-made bypass pruner with forged aluminum handles and a hardened steel blade, designed for clean cuts up to about 1 inch.

  • Bypass cutting action, right-handed, large hand size
  • 8.46 in (215 mm) length; 0.55 lb (251 g)
  • Cutting capacity: 0.98 in (25 mm)
  • Forged aluminum handles; hardened steel blade
  • Replaceable parts and lifetime warranty from FELCO

Specifications summarized from FELCO product information. Demonstration listing — not an authorized FELCO reseller.
